entries.08de5e70e004b262: Tokyo Electron Limited purchases and sells equipment made by subsidiaries such as Tokyo Electron Technology Solutions, Tokyo Electron Kyushu and Tokyo Electron Miyagi. Maintenance services are provided by Tokyo Electron FE, overseas subsidiaries and others.

entries.48faeb32bb8f9549: This is equipment used in testing (inspection) to determine whether the chips formed on a wafer are good.

entries.4a9fd0241fa9b37a: This equipment removes film on the wafer along the circuit pattern created by coating, exposure and developing.
entries.524b09bcf51292e3: A light-sensitive resin (photoresist) is evenly applied to a [[term:wafer|wafer]] (the round plate that forms the basis of a semiconductor chip); after the circuit pattern is transferred with an exposure tool, part of the resin is dissolved and removed with developer solution to form the circuit pattern.

entries.6da339f79479cb62: This equipment forms extremely thin films on the wafer surface, such as insulating films (films that do not conduct electricity) and metal films, which become the materials for devices and wiring.
entries.6e1e37f45648dfbb: This is equipment that removes foreign matter and other contaminants from circuits between manufacturing steps to prevent defects from forming.
